working_definition: Nuclei of the authors' 'Adult alary muscle' cluster(s) (Saavedra et al. 2023, Figure 3a), dissected adult male thoraces, control genotype.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Muscle cell of a bilateral adult heart muscle that is involved in modulation of the flow of hemolymph into the cardiac tube, and support of the dorsal vessel during locomotion.

justification: The authors' annotation 'Adult alary muscle' (Fly Cell Atlas-based).
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00003545 adult alary muscle cell (exact match).
